title: Homelab / Self-Hosted Server
description: Working on setting up a personal homelab server. Planning to self-host services, experiment with containerization (Docker/Portainer), and use it as a dedicated environment for learning infrastructure and networking hands-on.

title: Local AI Setup
description: Exploring the world of running large language models locally. Studying hardware requirements — GPU VRAM, compute needs, and model quantization — to find the right setup for running LLMs like LLaMA or Mistral on my own machine without relying on cloud APIs.
note: Currently evaluating GPU options and benchmarking quantized models.
